title: Billabong International Ltd - proposed acquisition of Rush Lifestyle Australia Pty Ltd retail stores

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Billabong International Ltd (Billabong), via a subsidiary GSM (Operations) Pty Ltd, proposes to acquire 36 retail stores of Rush Lifestyle Australia Pty Ltd (Rush).
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the competitive effects of the proposed acquisition in the context of the following markets: -Markets for the retail supply of casual wear, including board sports apparel, accessories and hardware in Cairns, Burleigh Heads and Mooloolaba, where the parties overlap; and -National market for the wholesale supply of casual wear, board sports apparel, accessories and hardware.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC took into account, amongst other factors: -That Billabong would continue to be competitively constrained in the local markets through the presence of other competing specialist sports apparel, accessories and hardware retailers in close proximity to Billabong/Rush stores in Cairns, Burleigh Heads and Mooloolaba; -The availability of specialist independent retailers as alternate avenues for wholesale distribution by rival wholesalers; and -The presence of alternate wholesalers of board sports apparel, accessories and hardware, including well-recognised brands. Accordingly, on 21 September 2010, the ACCC decided not to oppose the proposed acquisition.
